metadata.title: Bookmark Scout - Modern Browser Bookmark Manager
metadata.description: A browser extension to search, organize, clean up, import/export, and save bookmarks with opt-in AI tools.

hero.title: Bookmark Scout
hero.description: A browser extension to search, organize, clean up, import/export, and save bookmarks. Powered by opt-in AI tools with multi-provider support.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to manage your bookmarks efficiently

aiRecommendations.title: Opt-in AI Tools
aiRecommendations.description: Folder suggestions, tags, summaries, and reorganization plans from the provider you choose: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, Mistral AI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Off by default.

instantSearch.title: Instant Search
instantSearch.description: Find bookmarks instantly with debounced search and folder filtering

dragAndDrop.title: Drag & Drop
dragAndDrop.description: Organize bookmarks and folders with intuitive drag-and-drop

quickAdd.title: Quick Add
quickAdd.description: Save the current tab to any folder with one click, or save links from the right-click menu

sidePanel.title: Side Panel
sidePanel.description: Browse and search bookmarks in the Chrome or Edge side panel

darkMode.title: Light & Dark Themes
darkMode.description: Follow your system theme or choose light or dark

bookmarksManager.title: Bookmarks Manager
bookmarksManager.description: Replace Chrome's bookmarks page with a folder tree, breadcrumbs, a resizable table, and a tools sidebar

maintenanceTools.title: Maintenance Tools
maintenanceTools.description: Find duplicates, clean tracking URLs, scan dead links and review repairs, fetch titles, flag privacy-sensitive URLs, and view statistics

importExport.title: Import/Export
importExport.description: Export HTML, JSON, Markdown, or CSV, and preview HTML or JSON imports before anything is written

savedSearches.title: Saved Searches
savedSearches.description: Save filters, sort, and folder scope as named smart views that always reflect your current bookmarks

keyboardShortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
keyboardShortcuts.description: Search, navigate, and save from the keyboard without overriding browser shortcuts. Press ? for help

undoDelete.title: Delete with Undo
undoDelete.description: Confirm before deleting, and undo any deletion for 10 seconds

techStack.title: Tech Stack
techStack.subtitle: Built with modern technologies for the best developer experience

step1.title: Download from GitHub Releases
step1.description: Download the latest CRX or ZIP asset for your browser

step2.title: Prepare the extension files
step2.description: Use the Chrome CRX directly, or unzip the downloaded browser archive

instructions.3: Drag in the CRX, or click Load unpacked
instructions.4: Select the extracted folder when using ZIP

footer.tagline: Search, organize, and clean up your bookmarks, right in your browser.
footer.madeBy: Made by {author}. Free and open source.
